integrity: One complete scientific claim with a self-contained proof, exact symbolic checker, and explicitly qualified related-work comparison.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimizer and Perron rate apply to iid homogeneous symmetric Bernoulli edge delivery on the four-cycle with a common gain, nonnegative stochastic synchronous updates and no additive noise. Asymptotic rates do not describe a finite-time optimum. The general covariance recursion predates this result. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain unperformed.
title: A sharp link-reliability threshold for fastest mean-square consensus on the four-cycle
